items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Then when Ronnell Bright came in, it started changing, going in another . . .

ctx.x: It was Joe Benjamin at first and John Malachi. Then Jimmy Jones had come back, because he was sick for a while. Then when he left, I think Ronnell Bright. Then Joe had an automobile accident. I think Richard Davis had come in. Then when Ronnell Bright came in, it started changing, going in another . . .
So that period, from basically – from ’54 to ’58 – is that? – it was late ’52? When did you . . .?
